protocol.title: Protocol Public-Goods Contributions
protocol.subtitle: Automatic forwards from the Cosmic Signature protocol to the Public Goods Vault
protocol.description: When a cycle finalizes, a percentage of its Cycle Reserve is forwarded to the Public Goods Vault. The vault holds these funds for the configured Public Goods recipient.

voluntary.title: Voluntary Public-Goods Contributions
voluntary.subtitle: Community members' voluntary contributions to the Public Goods Vault
voluntary.description: Beyond automatic protocol forwards, community members can make voluntary contributions to the Public Goods Vault. These contributions reflect the Cosmic Signature community's commitment to supporting public-goods initiatives through on-chain coordination.

retrievals.title: Public Goods Retrievals
retrievals.subtitle: Funds retrieved from the Public Goods Vault
retrievals.description: Track funds forwarded from the Cosmic Signature Public Goods Vault to its configured Public Goods recipient.
